props.statsLabel: Trusted moving experience in the Midlands

props.title: Meticulous care for your home and belongings
props.subtitle: Based at Fairgate House on Kings Road, we treat every piece of furniture, family heirloom, and office asset with total care and diligence.

items.title: Comprehensive Goods in Transit Insurance
items.text: Every load is fully covered with goods in transit and public liability insurance for complete peace of mind.

items.title: Full Packing & Unpacking Service
items.text: High quality double-walled boxes, wardrobe cartons, bubble wrap, and mattress covers handled by our trained team.

items.title: Secure Containerized Storage
items.text: Clean, dry, and CCTV-monitored storage facilities for short and long-term storage between property moves.

items.title: Transparent Fixed Prices
items.text: No hidden key waiting charges or surprise fees on moving day. Accurate fixed written estimates.

props.title: Tailored moving packages across the UK
props.description: From local 1-bedroom flat moves in Solihull to full corporate office relocations across the UK.

services.title: Full House Removals
services.text: Complete house packing, dismantling, transport, and reassembly with specialized protective floor coverings.

services.title: Commercial & Office Relocations
services.text: Weekend and evening office relocations minimizing downtime with crate hire, IT disconnect/reconnect, and archive moves.

services.title: Secure Containerized Storage
services.text: Direct loading from your door into sealed wooden storage containers with round-the-clock security monitoring.

services.title: Professional Packing Materials
services.text: Heavy-duty moving kits, bubble wrap, packing paper, tape, and garment hanging wardrobes delivered in advance.
